blocks.text: Team preview of the Dallas Mavericks ahead of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Last NBA season: 26-56, missed playoffs Coach: Dusty May (first-time NBA head coach, hired June 22). Additions: F Morez Johnson Jr., G Sergio De Larrea, F Zaccharie Risacher, F Santi Aldama, G Marcus Sasser.
